where.screen_path: No UI surfaces touched this session. Phase E4 cut 2 is pure substrate work (proof-required policy evaluators), the officials-roster extraction is an internal refactor with consumer-import updates, and the dedicated test file is non-UI coverage. UI work waits for Phase E4 cut 3 (org-creation membership-policy picker, Members view, publish-roster button, Profile join-an-org flow).

what.action: Three-commit session shipping Phase 8 Phase E4 cut 2 (proof-required join-policy evaluators), the prior-letter-named officials-roster extraction (createOrganization.ts → officialsRoster.ts sibling, drops file under the 400-line soft warn), and a dedicated test file for the extracted module closing a long-standing coverage gap.
what.summary: Operator opened with 'Fire up and take the next chunk of code to progress things the way you see fit fill up context enough to stop hook clean' — explicit full-chunk delegation, third such opening in a row. Phase E4 cut 2 had one upstream directional question (proof-attachment shape) that doctrine PFOR-019 required to be chipped before code touched disk; carpenter surfaced the question as a four-option chip and operator picked the recommended DisclosureProof-for-handshake+credential, cosignatures-for-vouch option. Cut 2 then split cleanly into builder extension (buildSelfMembershipDraft gains optional fourth proofs parameter that bakes handshake_proof + credential_proof leaves carrying JSON-stringified DisclosureProofBundles, with paired reader helpers readHandshakeProof + readCredentialProof; vouch needs no new leaf because cosignatures already ride envelope.signatures[]), evaluator extension (evaluateJoinPolicy in governance/ flips the three Phase-E3-deferred returns into real verification: handshake reads handshake_proof and runs verifyDisclosureProof + asserts meta.kind=relationship + signers include joiner AND one pubkey from policy.with_any_of; credential reads credential_proof and runs verifyDisclosureProof + asserts meta.kind=credential + meta.subject=joiner + leaf value matches policy.credential_type + when policy names an issuer the signers include them; vouch derives known-member set inline from holdings via predicate logic duplicated here rather than reverse-importing from connections, counts known-member cosigners minus joiner against policy.from_any_member_count), and tests (evaluateJoinPolicy.test.ts grows 13→21 covering happy-path + every reject reason; createMembership.test.ts grows 18→22 covering the builder + readers + receiveSelfMembership happy-path on requires_credential; verifyOpenJoinedMembership.test.ts flips three Phase-E4-deferred assertions to assert the new concrete reject reasons). After cut 2 landed with healthy context budget remaining, the second commit shipped the prior letter's recommended officials-roster extraction: 198 lines (Official, RatificationSummary, isOfficialsRoster, readOfficials, findLatestOfficialsRoster, countRatifications, publishOfficialsRoster + internal helpers HEX_64, sortOfficials, uniqueByPubkey) moved to src/features/connections/officialsRoster.ts mirroring openMemberRoster.ts on the membership-direction half; createOrganization.ts drops from 546 to 368 lines (back under the 400-line soft warn); five consumer sites updated to import from the new module rather than from a back-compat re-export. The third commit ships officialsRoster.test.ts with 16 focused tests on the extracted public surface — coverage that never existed in createOrganization.test.ts. All four gates green across all three commits.

why.text: Phase E4 cut 2 was named as the recommended first move by the prior letter, with the design fully concrete except for the proof-attachment shape question — and that question is exactly the kind of directional decision PFOR-019's chip-form rule was built to surface. Chip up front rather than silent-pick, because the choice locks the on-wire envelope shape for every future open-joined-with-proof self-membership. Operator picked the recommended DisclosureProof option (smaller envelopes, single-leaf reveal aligned with the Tapscript-style discipline the codebase already uses for authorized_by leaves). Cut 2's design then split into builder + evaluator + tests with no further ambiguity. The officials-roster extraction was named in five consecutive close-out letters as worth doing; it had been deferred each time because more substantive work was in front of it. With cut 2 substrate landed and context budget healthy, the mechanical refactor was the natural follow-up: it drops createOrganization.ts back under soft warn, makes the officials-vs-open-member parallel legible at the filesystem level (officialsRoster.ts = who runs the org, openMemberRoster.ts = who has joined the org, createOrganization.ts = the declaration pointing to both), and the import-site churn was bounded to five files. The third commit (dedicated test file) was a coverage opportunity surfaced by the extraction: the 198 lines had zero dedicated tests under either name; closing that gap brought the new module up to the same coverage discipline openMemberRoster.ts ships with.

outcome.notes: [P-001] done — chip-form question surfaced for proof-attachment shape; operator picked DisclosureProof+cosigs. [P-002] done — buildSelfMembershipDraft gains optional SelfMembershipProofs parameter baking handshake_proof + credential_proof leaves as JSON-stringified DisclosureProofBundles; vouch uses existing signatures[]. [P-003] done — readHandshakeProof + readCredentialProof reader helpers ship with lightweight shape gating returning null on absent/malformed leaves. [P-004] done — evaluateJoinPolicy flips three Phase-E3-deferred returns into real verification (handshake via meta.kind + verification leaf + signer-set intersection; credential via meta.kind + meta.subject + credential_type + optional issuer; vouch via inline known-member derivation from holdings). [P-005] done — verifyOpenJoinedMembership signature stays stable per prior letter. [P-006] done — evaluateJoinPolicy.test.ts 13→21; createMembership.test.ts 18→22; verifyOpenJoinedMembership.test.ts three Phase-E4-deferred tests flipped. [P-007] done — Officials roster + ratifications extracted to officialsRoster.ts sibling (198 lines); createOrganization.ts 546→368 (back under 400-line soft warn). [P-008] done — Five consumer sites updated to direct imports; no back-compat re-exports. [P-009] done — officialsRoster.test.ts shipped with 16 focused tests closing the long-standing coverage gap. [P-010] done — Manifest updated with two paragraphs (Phase E4 cut 2 detail + extraction paragraph) and three new touches entries. [P-011] done — All four gates green: typecheck clean, eslint clean, 255 of 255 tests passing (221→239→239→255 across the three commits), build OK with all bundle budgets within limits. [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: the chip-form question surfaced one design choice that the prior letter had explicitly named as 'worth the chip-form question up front' — this is a pattern worth naming in future briefs that have a single locking-the-on-wire-shape decision: prior carpenter signals the chip is needed; next carpenter surfaces it on session-start; one round-trip and the design locks. The PFOR-019 + carpenter-to-carpenter handoff loop worked exactly as designed here.

confidence.uncertainty: Phase E4 cut 2 verification paths are pure composers over already-tested substrate (verifyDisclosureProof from tapit-attest, evaluateJoinPolicy's list-checking from Phase E3, signature counting on envelope.signatures[]); the new test surface exercises happy paths + every named reject reason. The one uncertainty surface: receiveSelfMembership's happy-path coverage on requires_credential goes through wallet.hold which hits anchorQueue.upsert which jsdom does not back, so the test asserts gate-passage by checking the thrown error (if any) is NOT a gate-shaped reject — that's a negative assertion rather than a positive one. Same uncertainty surface as Phase E2/E3 carried forward; not blocking, just honest. The officials-roster extraction is mechanical (move + rewire imports + test); the consumer-import update was bounded to five files all of which typecheck + lint + run their tests cleanly. The officialsRoster.test.ts file ships 16 tests covering the previously-untested public surface; publishOfficialsRoster's IndexedDB-bound happy path stays unverified for the same reason openMemberRoster.test.ts leaves it unverified.

next: Phase E4 cut 3 — UI wiring. Org-creation form gains a membership-policy picker (open / allow_list / requires_handshake / requires_credential / requires_vouch); org-mode Identity tab gains a Members view rendering the chronological roster (founder first by anchor height, joiners after) plus a publish-roster button + pending-delta surface; any-wallet Profile gains a Join-an-org flow (paste / scan org pubkey → see declared join policy → click Join → self-membership signed + shipped over Mycelium; the Join flow for requires_handshake / requires_credential needs UI to let the joiner pick which held attestation to disclose as proof). Brief estimates 1-2 sessions for cut 3. Alternative moves if cut 3 is too UI-heavy: Phase D charter-amendment chain (walkCharterChain + findActiveCharter + dissolution — does NOT depend on Phase E substrate); centralize receiveSelfMembership's orgSelfDecl lookup inside the function (the consistency question the prior letter named — chip-worthy because it changes the create-attestation function family's calling convention); authRule.ts 430-line trim (in the soft-warn band but no obvious clean extraction point yet — would need design).
